content: निःसृ €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To come forth, slip away from, go out, issue from; बाणैः खरकार्मुकनिःसृतैः <ls>Rām.</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 25</ls>. .²2 To depart, set out for; ग्रामादरण्यं निःसृत्य निवसेन्नियतेन्द्रियः <ls>Ms. 6. 4</ls>. .²3 To flow forth, ooze out, exude; यो हेमकुम्भस्तननिःसृतानाम् <ls>R. 2. 36</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To turn out, expel, drive away.
